name: omnilab/ncbi
description: Omnilab NCBI: a gene of NCBI Gene by its GeneID - symbol, name, organism, place on the genome, summary, its UniProt and Ensembl ids - and a taxon of NCBI Taxonomy by its id or a name - scientific name, rank, lineage, common name, GBIF key - and a search of either, through NCBI Datasets v2 and E-utilities, no key needed (one for ten calls a second).
